tasks.label: Research: one-time manuscript setup (Git safety, token storage on Linux)
tasks.command: if [ -d manuscript/.git ]; then cd manuscript && git config core.hooksPath tools/githooks && git config core.fileMode false && git config pull.rebase false && chmod +x tools/githooks/pre-commit; else echo No manuscript clone in manuscript/ yet: nothing to set up.; fi

linux.command: if [ -d manuscript/.git ]; then cd manuscript && git config core.hooksPath tools/githooks && git config core.fileMode false && git config pull.rebase false && chmod +x tools/githooks/pre-commit && ( { git config --global --get credential.helper || git config --system --get credential.helper; } >/dev/null || git config credential.helper "store --file='$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir)/overleaf-credentials'"); else echo No manuscript clone in manuscript/ yet: nothing to set up.; fi

windows.command: if (Test-Path manuscript/.git) { Set-Location manuscript; git config core.hooksPath tools/githooks; git config core.fileMode false; git config pull.rebase false } else { echo No manuscript clone in manuscript/ yet: nothing to set up. }
